capability.name: MCP registry entry check: do its packages and its domain still name it
capability.description: Reads a server's entry from the official MCP registry and repeats, as things stand now, the ownership checks the registry ran at publish time: npm package.json mcpName, the PyPI and NuGet README's mcp-name token (the registry's own boundary rule). For a domain namespace it looks for a well-formed MCPv1 key in DNS at the domain or its parent (dns.google) and, when you give domain, at /.well-known/mcp-registry-auth. Verdict verified, verified_partly or mismatch by the registry's rules, with every check and what was not checked (OCI, Cargo, MCPB) and why; warnings for what the registry does not check (deprecated, yanked, a package repository under another GitHub owner). It does not say the code is safe or who published a version.

domain.description: the namespace's domain, to also read its /.well-known/mcp-registry-auth

note: before you approve a registry server: do its packages and domain still name it
